goal: Fix build failures in the Guix codesigning environment when building from source without substitutes
Prevents a division by zero error triggered during oscrypto benchmark tests on fast machines
agreement: Concept support to fix the issue now while working on more robust dependencies (fanquake)
Suggested upstreaming the patch to Guix and splitting a change into a separate PR (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it resolves an environment failure when building from source without substitutes
It only impacts guix-codesign builds and does not affect regular release builds or CI runs
